scope: Exploratory ordinary late-fusion B/C/D information decomposition; 30 new fits; reuse 15 archived full-information late-fusion fits; no added backbone, cohort, or network module

training.sampler: Existing SCC-only weighted replacement sampler, inner-training counts only
training.selection: First strict maximum of inner-validation BACC
training.randomness: Reset the paired seed after model initialization; preserve original seeded sampler

inference.internal: One held-out prediction per image per seed; pooled OOF over frozen five outer folds
inference.external: Original 1701 cases, exact original ordering/exclusions; evaluate all five fold models; aggregate per-class recalls with original fixed fold support weights; no probability ensemble
inference.evaluation_release: Freeze all chosen new fits and checkpoint inventories before any new outer/external outcome access

primary_information_contrasts: C-B: ordinary late fusion age_recorded minus age_only
D-C: archived full-information ordinary late fusion minus age_recorded
metrics: BACC in percent; differences in percentage points
statistics.bootstrap_scope: Independent patient-cluster sampling within each cohort, shared draws across arms and seeds; fixed models and fixed external fold weights. Percentile 95% descriptive unadjusted intervals. No model-fit resampling.
statistics.seed_summary: Show all three paired seed deltas, mean and sample SD; never label as five-seed results
prohibited_claims: Causal effect of recording or biological sex
State-of-the-art superiority from adapted five-feature baselines
Isolated fusion-mechanism effect where visual representations and heads differ
General validity across training recipes from a single chosen recipe
Fusion-design invariance unless supported by both designs

preflight_requirements: Verify original environment, source snapshots, splits and ImageNet weights
Verify both unchanged late-fusion models and B/C initialization equivalence
Release batch-2 computation graph before AMP batch-16 memory qualification
Complete two separate one-epoch engineering trials on inner train/valid only
Freeze all 30 fits before any new held-out or external evaluation
failure_policy: Document all failed attempts. Restart a failed fit from its fixed seed only for technical reasons, retaining logs. If protocol changes affect comparability, version the plan before outcomes; do not selectively rerun poor results or add seeds based on significance.
public_release_policy: No new case-level public release is authorized by this plan. Existing code-publication task and data-disclosure decision remain separate.
implementation_status: Worker pipeline implemented; GPU qualification and two one-epoch engineering trials remain mandatory
hypothesis_policy: Follow-up selected after observing DSMAF B/C/D results. No external-outcome model tuning, selective seed replacement, or stopping on significance. Report all outcomes even if inconsistent across fusion designs.
readiness_policy: No GPU result is assumed. Original RTX4060 must pass both model checks and two one-epoch trials before formal training.
working_data_policy: Local handoff to the original RTX4060 only; no public patient-level upload and no journal submission by this pipeline.
comparison_policy: The original controls.npz contains 45 verified legacy fits. Only the 15 late_fusion fits form D in the two declared contrasts; other legacy arms are retained for integrity checking and descriptive reference, not additional hypotheses.
